description: Create a special mood and fill the day with bliss with the Glade Cotton Cloud Dream jar candle. It's part of our Limited Edition Positive Vibes Collection, specially designed to help you unlock the vibes of the spring season. These small jar candles have been expertly crafted by our master perfumers. With fragrance infused with essential oils and feel-good ingredients, they have light and airy notes of cotton, airy clouds and sunkissed skies. Just light up one of these fragrant candles and boost the mood with Cotton Cloud Dream. They're masterfully designed glass jar candles that fill the room with superior scent and glow. It's a pretty way to unlock the feeling of spring. Plus, the good vibes keep going – these small scented candles are made without parabens, phthalates or formaldehydes. To find your vibe, check out the entire Limited Edition Positive Vibes Collection. If you're looking for an easy way to brighten up your day, a fragrant candle is an excellent choice, and we've got one to match your mood. So go ahead, turn up the good vibes and create an air of spring in any space with a Cotton Cloud Dream scented candle. Candle burning tips: For best performance, burn two to four hours at a time. This will maximize the life of your candle. Trim the wick to 1/4 inch each time before you burn, and be sure to remove any wick debris in the candle before lighting. Do not touch, lift or move a burning candle. Wait until the wax has cooled and hardened before touching a candle. For optimal performance, keep burning candles away from drafts, vents and air currents. Stop using your Glade Jar Candle when 1/4 inch of wax remains. Be sure the candle jar is placed on a stable, heat-resistant surface. Never place flammable materials near a candle. Never burn candles unattended. Do not burn candles where they can be knocked over by children, pets or anyone else.
